name: api-to-sdk
description: Turn an OpenAPI 3.0 / 3.1 spec (YAML or JSON) into a typed TypeScript SDK package: types for every schema, a dependency-free fetch client with one method per operation (path, query and header parameters, JSON / multipart / form bodies, bearer / API key / basic auth, timeouts, ApiError with the parsed error body), a README and an example that calls every operation, plus a mock server built from the spec's examples. Verified automatically: strict TypeScript compile, then every operation is called against the mock and checked against the spec.

Verified automatically: strict TypeScript compile, then every operation is called against the mock and checked against the spec.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 OpenAPI 3.0 / 3.1 规范（YAML 或 JSON）生成带完整类型的 TypeScript SDK 包：每个数据结构都有类型；基于 fetch、没有依赖的客户端，每个接口一个方法（路径/查询/请求头参数，JSON / multipart / 表单请求体，Bearer / API Key / Basic 认证，超时，带解析后错误内容的 ApiError）；附 README、调用全部接口的示例，以及用规范示例搭建的模拟服务器。自动验证：TypeScript 严格模式编译，再逐个调用每个接口并按规范检查。
